title: Ignition Coil "A" Primary Control Circuit Low
plain: The computer sees low voltage on the control wire for ignition coil A (usually the coil for one cylinder). That cylinder may not be getting a spark.
symptoms: Engine misfire, shaking or rough running

causes.name: Coil control wire shorted to ground

checks: Swap the coil with another cylinder and see if the problem follows it
Inspect the coil connector and wiring
fix: Replace the ignition coil if it is bad, and repair any shorted wiring.
urgent_if: If the check engine light is flashing or the engine is shaking hard, pull over when it's safe and turn the engine off. Don't keep driving; a heavy misfire can overheat and ruin the catalytic converter and leave you without power in traffic. Have it towed or checked right away.

title: Ignition Coil "A" Primary Control Circuit High
plain: The computer sees high voltage or an open circuit on the control wire for ignition coil A. That cylinder may not be getting a spark.
symptoms: Engine misfire, shaking or rough running

causes.name: Unplugged or broken coil connector or wire
Coil control wire shorted to power

checks: Check that the coil connector is fully seated
Swap the coil with another cylinder and see if the problem follows it
fix: Repair the connector or wiring, or replace the coil if it has failed.
urgent_if: If the check engine light is flashing or the engine is shaking hard, pull over when it's safe and turn the engine off. Don't keep driving; a heavy misfire can overheat and ruin the catalytic converter and leave you without power in traffic. Have it towed or checked right away.

title: Ignition Coil "A" Secondary Circuit
plain: Ignition coil A isn't producing a proper high-voltage spark, or the spark is leaking away before it reaches the spark plug.
symptoms: Engine misfire, shaking or rough running

causes.name: Worn spark plug or wide plug gap
Cracked coil boot or plug wire
Oil or water in the spark plug well

checks: Check the spark plug and coil boot for wear, cracks or oil
Swap the coil with another cylinder to see if the misfire follows it
fix: Replace the worn spark plug and/or ignition coil.
urgent_if: If the check engine light is flashing or the engine is shaking hard, pull over when it's safe and turn the engine off. Don't keep driving; a heavy misfire can overheat and ruin the catalytic converter and leave you without power in traffic. Have it towed or checked right away.

title: Cylinder 1 Above Knock Threshold
plain: The knock sensor has picked up strong knocking (pinging) from cylinder 1. Knocking is fuel burning at the wrong time and can damage the engine if it keeps happening.
symptoms: Pinging or knocking sound when accelerating
Loss of power as the computer pulls back timing

causes.name: Wrong spark plugs or a faulty knock sensor
Internal engine noise mistaken for knock

checks: Fill up with the fuel octane your owner's manual calls for
Check for cooling, lean-running or other engine codes
fix: Use the right fuel and fix any overheating or lean condition; carbon cleaning or sensor replacement may be needed.
